bracketing_exemplars: Kent State QB 2026 (32, this round - proven-but-modest returning starter)
Buffalo QB 2026 (22, this round - zero FBS tape)
rationale_bullets: Split-print battle: Athlon expects Gotkowski ('expected to be QB1 in the fall'); PS's lineup starts Kansas RS McComb (PS #34, zero tape).
Gotkowski's tape is thin and mixed: 59.1/109, 575 @ 44%, 4-1 - late-season wins over Buffalo/Ball St ('saved their season' - HC) then significant regression in the title game and bowl.
D2 Heavner (3,239 + 1,017 rush at Fort Hays - feed-gap) adds real no-cell volume; Finn (MAC MVP '23, left the team in November) and Hesson both expired.
30, L: some returning FBS tape + P4-RS pedigree beats the zero-tape rooms (UMass/Buffalo 22); the 44% completion rate and open battle cap it under KSU's 32.
data_gaps: no candidate above 109 FBS pass snaps

rationale_bullets: Headliner add: Rodney Nelson - FCS Monmouth CAA PLAYER OF THE YEAR (1,802 @ 6.2, 18 TD); Athlon expects 'the bulk of the carries' (origin verified vs feed; PS's Merrimack/Fort-Hays variants rejected).
Real support: Wisconsin's Yacamelli (64.6/38; B10 +5 tiny) + returning rFr Jones 79.8/62 (277 @ 4.4, 1 st, PS #169).
Loses Brunson 75.3 (767 yds) + Tracy to expiry, but the committee's quality arguably improves.
26: FCS-POY-led committee lands just under CMU/BGSU's 28 (their FBS tape beats his no-cell tape) and far over Buffalo's 16.
Loses ~2,050 receiving yards: Perry 77.3/370 (976 @ 22.7) -> Colorado, Weaver 69.7/400 (642) -> Syracuse, Colzie expired, TE Shane 78.6 expired.
Reynolds 64.4/324 (12 st, 352; ex-Washington) is the one proven returnee; Isom 60.6/166 next.
The reload is P4-pedigree-over-tape: Witten (Ohio State DNP, PS WR #22), Hyatt (Arizona), Q.Simmons (Kentucky RS), feed-gap Jenkins/Huggins; TE = rFr Zvonar + Memphis's Ross.
24: one 12-start anchor + credentialed unknowns - between Buffalo's 22 and KSU's four-mid-piece 26. 'Almost all the receivers will be newcomers' (Athlon).
data_gaps: P4 adds have ~10 combined FBS targets

bracketing_exemplars: Central Michigan OL 2026 (28, this round - previous round-best)
rationale_bullets: The round's most experienced room: ~49 returning FBS starts (E.Smith 14 at LT with 2nd/3rd-Tm MAC honors, Manu 14 at C, G.Smith 14, Schorsch 7) PLUS NIU's Malcore - 74.5/715, 32 career starts, 3rd-Tm MAC - the best imported OL tape of the round.
Honors-vs-grade tension priced: E.Smith's 44.7 raw is the round's worst returning-honoree grade; PBLK graded p3 with largely this personnel - but RBLK graded p76 (this line mauls in the run game).
Depth is real: Lowry 78.4/92, Lawhorn Moore 81.8/39, Butler 69.6/150, Duquesne's 1st-Tm NEC Beidatsch, OSU's Armstrong. Loses RT Terrill 76.8/734 -> Houston.
30: edges CMU's 28 on Malcore + start volume; the pass-pro tape keeps it well under the p50 region.

bracketing_exemplars: Bowling Green DL 2026 (34, this round - elite returning edge)
rationale_bullets: Loses the star - Trick 91.3/671 (1st-Tm MAC, 8.5 sk) -> Texas Tech (who also took KSU's Mathis: TTU harvested the MAC's two best edges) - plus NT Washington (expired).
But keeps the round's DEEPEST returning rotation: ~2,200 snaps at 57-65 raw (Andrews 62.9/486 with 13 st, Jobe, Rice, Schott, Bell, Lyons, Alexander).
Real FBS import: Cincinnati starter Coleman (57.6/449, 12 st) + Purdue RS Moore (8 st at Akron '24).
28: floor-high, ceiling-modest - above CMU's 24 on depth, below BGSU's 34 (Bradley beats anyone here). PRSH p90 fades with Trick.

The reload beats the exodus: CJ Young (74.3/563, 2nd-Tm All-MAC at Kent State - a double-feed-gap walk-on move, print-adjudicated both sides) + Myrick (1st-Tm All-Sun Belt '24; 62.0/599, 11 st at South Alabama LY) + McCain 65.1/586 (73 tkl, leading returning tackler).
Uihlein 90.7/124 (8 st, 'steady performer') is the round's best small-sample LB grade.
Departed: Kuwatch 82.1/703 (#1 tklr) + Hondru 82.2/487 (2nd-Tm MAC) - both expired; the imports replace honors with honors.
38: the deepest honors-bearing LB room of the round - Athlon calls it 'the strongest unit,' Martin his best group; just under the UNLV-40 anchor on offset drag.
data_gaps: two import starters in a new scheme

rationale_bullets: Loses 2,300+ snaps of the round's best safety tape: Blakey 84.1/911 (1st-Tm MAC, #1 tklr) + Walters 74.0/761 (2nd-Tm) expired, Beasley 71.3/647 -> Kansas State.
Returns two volume CBs - K.Martin 61.3/567 + Walker 66.2/314 - and converts Yharbrough 63.1/655 to safety (Withdrawn-portal override STAYS; 'impressed in the spring').
P4 pedigree fills: Tatum (MSU 9-st history -> NW '25), Minich (ND), Knighten (40 tkl at NIU '23-24; Indiana MedRS), Ellens (ISU RS).
26: two returning volume corners + a converted starter beats CMU's one-anchor 22; the unproven safety pair keeps it under EMU's 28.
data_gaps: P4 adds have thin recent tape

bracketing_exemplars: Central Michigan ST 2026 (26, this round - previous round-best)
Kent State ST 2026 (26, this round - elite returners, empty kicking)
rationale_bullets: Everything returns except the placekicker: P Stainton (63 punts, 42.3, 39.9 net, 12-50+), KR Reynolds (3rd-Tm MAC, 28.5, TD), PR Billups-Williams (4th-Tm MAC, 9.8), KO specialist McLaughlin (71 KO/40 TB).
The lone loss is real - Dzioban (1st-Tm MAC, 20-23, program-best 86.8% career) -> Auburn - and his replacement is a pedigreed 3-year specialist with a 2-2 career FG line, not a walk-on.

The systemic component is print-corroborated at the institutional level: 'one of the best special teams coordinator jobs in the country... always top-25 efficient' (opposing coach); PS STR #21 '25 / #1 '23.
40: the round's best ST room by a wide margin - two all-conference returners + proven P + elite system, docked for the FG hole.
